description: This file defines an interface for message bus interactions in the ssp_messagebus_interface component. It includes function declarations for engaging with the message bus, initialization, finalization, resource cleanup, and bus checking.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up resources related to the message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, based on priority and user data.
